dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Hello there! Are you here to join the Kujirai Guild?

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Oh, right. I thought you were here to join the Guild. So you don't recognize me, huh.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Allow me to introduce myself, then. I am the successor to the Kujirai Fishing Method and the founder of the Kujirai Guild — Kujirai Momiji, daughter of the ocean!

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: *sigh* Come on, don't look at me like that.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: As a fisherwoman, I was born near the ocean, grew up near the ocean... and someday, I will return to it as well.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: So there should be no problem in me calling myself the "daughter of the ocean" and stuff, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: It's an association for the children of the sea...

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: *cough* Sorry, was that too hard to understand? Let me try that again.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: The Kujirai Guild was created by yours truly, and it's a fishing association revolving around the Kujirai Fishing Method.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: It's not the biggest organization around, but each of our members is a certified ace angler!

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: And it is my belief that with our hereditary art, the Kujirai Fishing Method, our guild will one day spread all over the land!

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: How about it, then? If you join now, you'll get to be a founder, y'know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to buy some fishing supplies.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Of course! We need excellent tools to do the work that we must, after all. You do indeed have the qualities of a child of the sea. Alright then, take your pick.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Bye! You're welcome back anytime if you want to join the Kujirai Guild.
